name: Munakata Itsuki
source:
He is a senpai clerk at "Plum Club," a video game arcade where the protagonist works part-time. He is a womanizer, and is always being warned by the protagonist, who is his kouhai, for hitting on female customers and staff.

He is a charismatic man who is mischievous but somehow still lovable. Although he is not a good worker, he is good at his job and is amiable, which makes his job run smoothly.

Although he looks like a simple man, he seems to be sharp and occasionally makes good points.

[Translated from [url=https://lupinuspalette-gam.wixsite.com/my-site?pgid=kv5kbz8l-ea0d28a7-b580-4242-a19a-8ec15accf6c5]official website[/url]]
